successful_rehearsal.scope: New resource-limited loopback PostgreSQL restoration and current-image ORM reads
exclusions: Download/decryption, operator response and source backup creation are outside the measured restoration interval.
Host, OS, DNS, TLS, proxy, configuration, provider and mail-service recovery are not rehearsed.
Production remains writable; a dump/source snapshot mismatch can reflect intervening writes and must not be called a successful comparison.
ORM reading does not decrypt MFA/outbox payloads, authenticate users or establish external mail delivery.

helper_failure_diagnosis.cause: Buffered header inspection reset the logical reader position but left the inherited file descriptor at byte4096; pg_restore skipped archive header.
helper_failure_diagnosis.fix: Use an unbuffered dump reader before header inspection and descriptor inheritance.

real_child_reproduction.scope: Local synthetic file plus real child stdin; no database or host restore

schema_comparison_scope: Logical columns, types, nullability, defaults, indexes, constraints and inventory; database roles, ownership and ACL restoration excluded.
